title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
abstract: arXiv:2608.29605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather

translated_title: 后见记忆-PRM：用可审计的后见信用监督记忆管理
translated_abstract: 长程LLM智能体的记忆操作难以监督：操作被执行时其价值是不可观测的。但它们有其特殊之处——它们会在轨迹中留下机器可读的证据：检索命中和回答时的引用。Hindsight Memory-PRM两次利用这一审计线索：离线用于训练一个以操作为条件的记忆效用评论家；在线则通过检索、引用以及每个探针一次受控的删除-重答操作，结算一个经干预校准的条目级存在信用，并沿版本链传播为动作级代理奖励——无需逐操作的人工标注，也无需对后续展开进行蒙特卡洛重放。在留出的LoCoMo基准上，在固定共享读取器的条件下，本地8B策略达到77.5%，超过其API教师（65.1%）及所有复现的外部系统，且上下文长度仅为Mem0官方工作点的八分之一；在LongMemEval上达到79.0%。消融实验将增益归因于因果校准而非……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Hindsight Memory-PRM，利用轨迹中检索命中与回答引用等可审计证据进行事后信用分配，无需逐操作人工标注即可监督长程LLM智能体的记忆管理，使本地8B模型在LoCoMo上以仅八分之一的上下文达到77.5%、超越其API教师，并在LongMemEval上达到79.0%。
en_tdlr: Hindsight Memory-PRM supervises long-horizon LLM agents' memory management by exploiting auditable evidence (retrieval hits and answer-time citations) for hindsight credit assignment, enabling a local 8B model to surpass its API teacher with 77.5% on LoCoMo at one-eighth the context and 79.0% on LongMemEval without per-operation human labels.
